Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper for a typed Lamport mutual exclusion specification. It declares a fixed system size with N == 3 and a maximum clock bound maxClock == 10, and introduces the state variables used to represent per-process logical clocks, received requests, acknowledgements, in-flight network messages, and the set of processes currently in the critical section. The module itself does not define the protocol actions or temporal properties; instead, it instantiates the LamportMutexTyped module, so this file serves as a concrete environment for model checking rather than a standalone behavioral specification.
